module: Mission telemetry tracker: follows the funnel (which missions start, how they are configured, how they end). The "missionRunning" activity carries the duration; one-off events report the click on Start, the opening of the start/end screens, each finished attempt, restarts, reconfigurations and abandonments.
notes: Never put a "name" key in the activity data: it would replace the activity name and the start and end events could no longer be matched.
The start/end screen nodes are also used outside missions (split-screen modes): events are only counted during a mission.
A mission built on the endScreenWhole node never triggers onEndScreenUIOpened; the results come from onMissionAttemptAggregated.
Activity end outcomes: stopped, abandoned, trackerUnloaded.

onAnyMissionChanged.desc: Hook called when the mission actually runs, for all start paths (including those that load a level first). Starts the missionRunning activity. startedFrom: missionScreen (in level), gameplaySelector, discover, withinMission (new attempt, next mission or reconfiguration from the end screen); starts from career tutorials, activity flows, multiplayer or scenarios give "other".

state.desc: State; only "started" is taken into account.

onAnyMissionWillChange.desc: Hook called before any mission stop, including the instant stop on a level change, a return to the menu or a career start (which skips onMissionStopped). Ends the activity with the outcome "stopped".

onUIStartButtonClicked.desc: Hook called on click of the Start button: emits missionStartButtonClicked (only during a mission).

onEndScreenUIOpened.desc: Hook called when the end screen opens: emits missionEndScreenOpened (without a result).

onMissionAttemptAggregated.desc: Hook called when an attempt is recorded (the only moment the full result exists as one table): emits missionAttemptCompleted (outcome, number, stars, time, penalty, points, vehicle model and config). The filled fields depend on the mission type.

onStartScreenFinishedBuilding.desc: Hook called when the start screen is built: emits missionStartScreenOpened only once per mission.

onRecoveryPromptButtonPressed.desc: Hook called on click of a recovery message button: if id is restartMission, emits missionRestarted.

onMissionReconfigured.desc: Hook called when a mission's settings change: emits missionReconfigured with only the modified settings.

onMissionAbandoned.desc: Hook called when the mission is closed prematurely: emits missionAbandoned (byPlayer, attemptsCompleted, which is 0 if no attempt was finished) and ends the activity with the outcome "abandoned". byPlayer is false when the game itself closes the mission, for example after a vehicle spawn failure.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Hook called on load: manual unload.

onExtensionUnloaded.desc: Hook called on unload (game close, Lua reload, tracker disabled): ends the activity with the outcome trackerUnloaded.
